project_type: Cost-minimized fully-serverless AWS quiz app. Backend: AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript) provisioning DynamoDB single-table (on-demand), ARM64 NodejsFunction Lambda, API Gateway v2 HTTP API, Cognito user pool (admin auth). Frontend: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript 5 multi-page SPA (public app index.html + admin admin.html), hosted by AWS Amplify Hosting.
build_system: Two separate npm projects. ROOT (CDK): npm scripts build=tsc, test=jest (ts-jest), cdk. FRONTEND (frontend/): npm scripts dev=vite, build=`tsc -b && vite build`. NodejsFunction bundles the Lambda with esbuild at synth time (externalModules: ['@aws-sdk/*']). No lockfiles committed in either project.
test_framework: ROOT: jest + ts-jest. test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts uses aws-cdk-lib/assertions (Template.fromStack, in-memory synth, esbuild bundling runs). test/handler.test.ts unit-tests PURE exported helpers from lambda/index.ts (no AWS mocking). FRONTEND: NO test runner exists and NONE may be added.
build_command: Backend (root): npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build. NONE can run in this sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry 403). User runs on a networked EC2 host.
test_command: Backend (root): npm test (jest). Frontend: none. Verify frontend correct-by-construction by reading.
verification_instructions: Sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY so npm install / tsc / jest / cdk synth / vite build CANNOT run here. Verify by reading: (1) existing HTTP API + its 7 routes + JWT authorizer + Cognito + DynamoDB table remain unchanged (existing stack tests must still pass); (2) NEW WebSocket API (AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api ProtocolType WEBSOCKET) with routes $connect/$disconnect/$default + custom action routes, a NEW ws Lambda, its execute-api:ManageConnections IAM permission, and DynamoDB TTL are asserted in test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts; (3) new pure helpers (room id gen, scoreboard aggregation, game-state transitions, participant-safe question projection) are unit-tested in the handler test suite and import the REAL exported functions; (4) answerIndex is NEVER sent to participant/browser clients; (5) frontend deps remain EXACTLY react + react-dom (native WebSocket only, no new deps, no lockfile); (6) single-player flows (list/chooseMode/quiz/result/history, all + oneByOne) untouched; (7) VITE_WS_URL threaded through config.ts + amplify.yml mirroring API_BASE. User then runs on a networked host: root `npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth` then `npx cdk deploy`; frontend `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`; set new Amplify env var WS_URL to the WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput and redeploy.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Do NOT generate lockfiles (neither root nor frontend commits one; created by the user on first install).
setup_instructions: No install possible in sandbox. On a networked host: root `npm ci` (or `npm install`), then `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npx cdk synth`, `npx cdk deploy`. Frontend: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`, `npm run dev` for local (http://localhost:5173). Some sandboxes need `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` prefix for npm (documented in README).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode: npm registry 403, so npm install / tsc / jest / cdk synth / vite build / npm run dev CANNOT run here. Author everything correct-by-construction and verify by reading. @aws-sdk/client-apigatewaymanagementapi is provided by the Lambda Node runtime; keep it esbuild-external like the other @aws-sdk/* modules (do NOT add it to root package.json dependencies unless needed only as a devDep type source; the existing pattern adds @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb + lib-dynamodb as root devDeps for the handler unit tests to import types/values, while esbuild keeps them external at bundle time). Do NOT attempt real AWS deploys or live WebSocket connections.
contribution_requirements: ADDITIVE only: preserve ALL existing behavior (HTTP API + 7 routes + JWT authorizer, single-player flows, admin flows, history, seeds). Keep cost-minimal serverless posture (WebSocket API + Lambda + DynamoDB on-demand, TTL cleanup, no VPC/NAT, no idle-billed resources). Frontend deps remain EXACTLY react + react-dom (native browser WebSocket API, no react-router, no new deps). Never expose answerIndex to participant/browser clients; scoring stays server-side reusing the stored answerIndex. Commit onto branch feat/realtime-battle. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator publishes).
key_patterns: BACKEND lib/quiz-app-stack.ts: single QuizAppStack. DynamoDB `table` (pk/sk STRING, PAY_PER_REQUEST, RemovalPolicy.DESTROY). NodejsFunction pattern: runtime NODEJS_22_X, architecture ARM_64, memorySize 256, timeout 10s, entry path.join(__dirname,'..','lambda','<file>.ts'), handler 'handler', bundling {minify:true, target:'node22', externalModules:['@aws-sdk/*']}. HTTP API via apigwv2.HttpApi + HttpLambdaIntegration + HttpJwtAuthorizer(issuer, {jwtAudience:[clientId]}). Cognito userPool + userPoolClient (public, no secret, implicit+code grant, Hosted UI domain prefix quiz-admin-<account>). CfnParameter adminAppBaseUrl; context flags allowedOrigin/includeLocalhostCallback/cognitoDomainPrefix. CfnOutputs: ApiEndpoint, TableName, UserPoolId, UserPoolClientId, UserPoolHostedUiDomain. For WebSocket API use aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2 WebSocketApi + WebSocketStage (autoDeploy) and aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2-integrations WebSocketLambdaIntegration; grant ManageConnections via `webSocketApi.grantManageConnections(wsFn)` OR an explicit iam PolicyStatement for execute-api:ManageConnections on `arn:aws:execute-api:...:*/*/POST/@connections/*` (grantManageConnections is the idiomatic path). DATA MODEL (single table): existing pk=QUIZ#<id> sk=META|Q#<n> stay untouched. New namespaced shapes e.g. pk=ROOM#<roomId> sk=META (room+game state), sk=CONN#<connId> (connection->name index), sk=PLAYER#<name> (score); add a Number `ttl` attribute and enable dynamodb TimeToLiveSpecification (Table timeToLiveAttribute:'ttl'). LAMBDA lambda/index.ts: routeKey dispatch (APIGatewayProxyEventV2). Pure exported helpers pattern: scoreAnswers, toPublicQuestions, validateAndNormalizeQuizInput/Update are pure + unit-tested. New ws handler lambda/ws.ts: APIGatewayProxyWebsocketEventV2 (event.requestContext.{connectionId,routeKey,domainName,stage}), dispatch on parsed body.action; post messages back with ApiGatewayManagementApiClient + PostToConnectionCommand (endpoint https://{domainName}/{stage}). Host auth: validate the Cognito JWT (the same id token the admin SPA already obtains via Hosted UI) that the host passes on createRoom (and control actions) against the pool JWKS/issuer/audience; participants connect with no token (name + roomId only). FRONTEND: config.ts reads import.meta.env.VITE_* (API_BASE default '/api', COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID) trailing-slash-stripped. auth.ts Hosted UI implicit-grant helpers: adminPageUrl()=origin+pathname (PAGE-AGNOSTIC, already works for index.html), loginUrl()/logoutUrl() build response_type=token URLs using adminPageUrl() as redirect_uri, restoreToken()/captureTokenFromHash()/saveToken()/clearToken() (sessionStorage key quizAdminToken, 60s margin, 3600s default). api.ts typed fetch client. HomePage.tsx is a no-router `type View='list'|'chooseMode'|'quiz'|'result'|'history'` state machine; sub-components in-file; Japanese UI copy; styles.css single stylesheet with design tokens + dark mode + prefers-reduced-motion. main.tsx -> HomePage (index.html); admin-main.tsx -> AdminPage (admin.html). IMPORTANT: because the host battle view lives in the PUBLIC app (index.html), the Cognito Hosted UI login for the host will redirect back to origin+'/index.html' (or origin+'/'), which is NOT currently in the app client callback/logout URLs (only /admin.html is). The stack must ADD the index.html (public app) callback + logout URLs to AdminAppClient so host login works, mirroring the existing adminAppBaseUrl + includeLocalhostCallback gating.
